'''Regretter's Rock''' was the name of a habitable [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] where, for several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] prior to the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] often wound up marooned.<ref name="Mission" /> By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Crime Doesn't Pay" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified pirate (Regretter's Rock)|pirate]] had become among the number of castaways marooned on the asteroid.<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with one of the two opposing governments in the Cold War sent a companion of theirs to Regretter's Rock to investigate what else might have been left there. The companion encountered the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], who agreed to lead them to his treasure in exchange for passage off Regretter's Rock.<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Regretter's Rock was mentioned in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the Crew Skill mission "Crime Doesn't Pay." The information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Mission" />
